dct_description_sm: This dataset presents the results of Random Forest models and simulated break-up timings within the Slave River Delta. It utilizes data from Landsat 8, Landsat 5, Sentinel-2A, and Sentinel-2B, spanning the melting period from 1984 to 2023.
dct_title_s: Ice break-up trends in Slave River Delta using satellite observations (1984-2023)
